scenario: A commercial lender processes a mid-project construction loan draw request for a mixed-use development. The loan officer uses the loan origination skill to spread the project's operating pro forma and normalize income/expense figures, then passes the normalized figures to the financial calculator to compute Debt-Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) and Loan-to-Value (LTV) metrics for the draw, and finally uses the reporting skill to generate a formal draw authorization packet.
info_flow: loan spreads and normalizes the construction project pro forma (income, expenses, add-backs) → financial-calculator computes DSCR and LTV from the normalized figures → reporting assembles a draw authorization packet citing the computed metrics.
